title: Keep Scroll in
tagline: Game of chance, double or nothing. Designed to fit on Scroll's blockchain
description:
The idea behind this project was to build a playful usecase for the Scroll testnet.
As for now, It's a double or nothing game where players can bet on the length of the Scroll.
Driving away from the classic coin flip's games, it can evolve in many directions with a focus on design, art and technology.
how_its_made:
It was built using React as a framework, to get dynamic files/states; and Ethers, to connect to the blockchain and send the transactions. 

The game's smart contract was written, tested & deployed on Remix. For now, the "random" length is created on-chain by encoding the owner address with the current block timestamp, and a Math function is JS.

Cool trick: the scroll is made of code. It's an <svg> element, which make it more easy to manipulate than an image.
